title: Occupancy and Residency Certification Servicing Manual — Start Date of a Health-Care Absence
content:
**§1 The start date.** Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, the absence start date is the date the monitored borrower left the home for health care: the departure date where every continuity limit is met and otherwise the facility admission date, per the plan's absence-start basis, never the date the accepted notice was received; another borrower's continued occupancy never moves it.

**§2 Continuity limits.** Every continuity limit is met when all four of the following hold:

1. the departure date is earlier than the facility admission date;
2. the calendar days from the departure date to the facility admission date are no more than the transfer window;
3. a facility letter is on file and the calendar days from the facility admission date to its contact date are no more than the corroboration window;
4. the calendar days from the facility admission date to the accepted notice's receipt are no more than the own-notice window.

A letter contact date or a notice receipt earlier than the facility admission date counts as zero days after it. Under the standard rule the departure date is the facility admission date and the transfer window, the corroboration window and the own-notice window are each zero days, so the absence start date is the facility admission date.

**§3 Records read.**

- *Monitored borrower:* the profile's primary borrower.
- *Facility admission date:* the date stated on the accepted health-care absence notice about that borrower received most recently, with the date that notice was received; where no such notice is on file, the handling date stands in for both.
- *Turned-away notice:* the rejected health-care absence notice about the monitored borrower received most recently, with the admission date it states, the date it was received, its reject reason and the person who sent it.
- *Facility letter:* an accepted supporting document on file about the monitored borrower, received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, on a plan whose supporting document setting is none; the letter read is the one received most recently, with the contact date it states.
- Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. Where two records share the date a reading is ordered by, the one entered first is read.

## Truth table of §2

| Departure before admission | Within transfer window | Facility letter on file and within corroboration window | Notice receipt within own-notice window | Absence start date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | the departure date |
| no | — | — | — | the facility admission date |
| yes | no | — | — | the facility admission date |
| yes | yes | no | — | the facility admission date |
| yes | yes | yes | no | the facility admission date |

*Hypothetical case.* With the departure date equal to the facility admission date and each window at zero days, condition 1 fails and the absence start date is the facility admission date, not the date the notice was received.
